mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three months indicates growing consumer confidence and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods following a sustained increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO declined by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) over a quarter indicates a shift in consumer spending from goods to services, which may lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases and RSAFS decreases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of the instances where GDPC1 increased and RSAFS decreased in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% over six months signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 2% over six months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreased by more than 100,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three months indicates a strengthening economy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where HOUST increased and UNRATE decreased over the same three-month period.
